--- alter_queue_replace_ttl.sql
ALTER QUEUE Q REPLACE ROW DELETION POLICY (OLDER_THAN(DeliverTime, INTERVAL 14 DAY))

--- AST
&ast.AlterQueue{
  Name: &ast.Path{
    Idents: []*ast.Ident{
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 12,
        NameEnd: 13,
        Name:    "Q",
      },
    },
  },
  QueueAlteration: &ast.ReplaceRowDeletionPolicy{
    Replace:           14,
    RowDeletionPolicy: &ast.RowDeletionPolicy{
      Row:        22,
      Rparen:     83,
      ColumnName: &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 54,
        NameEnd: 65,
        Name:    "DeliverTime",
      },
      NumDays: &ast.IntLiteral{
        ValuePos: 76,
        ValueEnd: 78,
        Base:     10,
        Value:    "14",
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
ALTER QUEUE Q REPLACE ROW DELETION POLICY ( OLDER_THAN ( DeliverTime, INTERVAL 14 DAY ))
